reviews.review_title: Good for what it is + Suggestions/Bugs
reviews.review_description:
i played the original game on pc and it was okay but not good enough for me to not refund it. the vr version is definitely an improvement though. not sure if there's more content than the original but for what it is right now id say its an alright game. it's pretty much just a more simplified cod zombies with unique guns made up of junk and toys which i love.

suggestions:
make it so magazines are a smooth insert instead of an instant snap.
add settings to adjust weapon offset similarly to pavlov (maybe also make it so every weapon can have a unique setup)
more content of any kind of course. more weapons, maps, cosmetics, etc.
your character moves EXTREMELY slow. either add a sprint function or a speed upgrade.

bugs:
as long as you're holding the grip button, you will grab ANYTHING nearby. i remember trying to reload guns in the main menu and randomly picking up a slipper from across the map. this can get really annoying really fast. this also lets you reload weapons all in 1 grip press which isn't really a bug i would say but i think its worth noting
idk if im just not doing it right but the charging handle on the sk8r (or whatever its called) doesn't work sometimes. im pulling it in the right direction but sometimes it takes a couple tries.
melee weapons are at really unusual angles and it makes it hard to use them sometimes.
